svg.title: Meridian Retail Group — Figure 6 — Delivery timeline
svg.text: Delivery timeline: four phases, five gates, 96 weeks
first value at week 10 · the five core workstreams as swimlanes · the dual-run window and its planned cost peak · client obligations as dependencies with lead times (§8.1–8.7, §9.2, §10.4, §10.6)
§8.1–8.7 · every phase ends in a decision point with defined evidence
8–14 week lead time (R8) — raise in week 1, delivered week 6
6 source credentials and read access, all 12 sources — rolling, per phase
WEEK 10 · FIRST VALUE — the regional daily trading dashboard in production, replacing four spreadsheets. Certified, SLO-backed, with published freshness.
Phase 0 foundations: network · identity · metastore · catalogs · tags · groups · CI/CD skeleton · cost attribution (D-09) · three proving connections
quality framework in anger: expectations, quarantine, alerting · the weekly quality report · runbooks written and rehearsed
POS EU ingest → bronze/silver · SAP inventory CDC · silver_reference · gold_trading · second POS schema conformed
all three POS schemas conformed · all 14 countries · e-commerce orders joined · metric views
PIM ingestion · conformed SCD2 product dimension · blocking gate on 3,100 unclassified SKUs · hierarchy published
SAP movements & purchasing · EDI · stock position · inbound pipeline · UC-3 and UC-2 in pilot
UC-2 and UC-3 to production, all regions · UC-4 markdown to production
SAP finance · FX · statutory hierarchy · trial position
finance parallel run vs the EDW — 3 months, zero unexplained variance
clickstream streaming ingest · identity resolution · silver_customer_pii · consent · UC-1 first release
UC-6 personalisation pilot — a holdout on every campaign
consumer migration — ~620 active EDW reports triaged; 35–45% retired
Hadoop migrated or retired — drained, not lifted
EDW and Hadoop switched off · client team running it
APAC + Americas to production · residency verified
Owner · domain owners and product managers
BOTH PLATFORMS RUNNING — the planned, time-boxed cost peak (§10.4)
client-side FTE overtakes services during Phase 3 — by design
legacy retiring to zero by week 88
§8.7 · numbered as pinned on the timeline
Named business owners for the 8 use cases
Kafka retention to 7 days + schema registry
Each one has a lead time that starts when it is asked for
All five, or it stays on
VALUE REALISATION AND THE COST PEAK
Cumulative payback falls in the first half of Year 2
A programme without real gates is a programme that cannot be stopped — and one that cannot be stopped cannot be trusted (§8.1).
